	id = zin_elves.73
	title = zin_elves.73.t
	desc = zin_elves.73.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_generic_sea
	trigger = {
		zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
		has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
		has_war = yes
		any_enemy_country = {
			capital_scope = { zin_is_region_east_lands = yes }
			NOT = { any_controlled_state = { zin_is_region_magical_lands = yes } }
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_quiet_asked }
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 30
	}
	timeout_days = 30
	immediate = {
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_elves_quiet_asked days = 120 }
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_elves.73.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 90
			modifier = {
				add = -70
				has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_carry_war
			}
		}
		random_enemy_country = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { zin_is_region_east_lands = yes } }
			save_event_target_as = zin_elves_quiet_foe
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_elves_quiet_foe }
			white_peace = event_target:zin_elves_quiet_foe
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_elves.73.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				add = 70
				has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_carry_war
			}
		}
	}
